title: Icon — folder
usage: 24 px keyline grid, 1.5 px square-capped ink strokes, one crimson accent on the part that acts.
rules: Render through <Icon> / .pp-icon as a one-ink mask (currentColor).
Sizes 16, 20 (default), 24; below 16 px use a text label.
Icon-only controls need an accessible name and a tooltip.
